title: Hai Raahnuma Himmate Mardanae Qasim
body:
Hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim (a.s)
Bhoolegi na duniya kabhi afsanay e Qasim, tareeq ke safhe hain yeh beganaye Qasim, har saheb-e-kirdaar hai deewanye Qasim, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim
Is umr mein woh jung ka andaaz nirala , bijli ne kiya Shaam ki faujaon mein ujala, tha jalwaye shamsheer se lashkar taho bala, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim
Thi jiski ki kalayi mein yadullah ki quwwat, dada sse mili thi jise virse mein shujayath, ta hashr jo hai maujizaye jurrath o himmat, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Bachpan mein jo rakhta hai buzurgaon ka irada, jo azam -e-hasan ka tha namuna woh khuzada , hai markaz-e- haq jiska banya huva jada, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim
Qasim ki nigahaon mein who shabbir ka maqsad, paband-e-riza raziye taqdeer ka maqsad, jaan dene mein tha khaom ki tameer ka maqsad, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim
Kya janiye thi madar-e-muztar ki tamanna , baba ki wasiyath thi gazamfar ki tamanna, puri huvi aakhir diley shabbar ki tamanna, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim
Maqbool na ho kislliye nauha tera sajid , kyon kar na tadap jaye harek aarif-o-Abid, mamdooh tera nusrath-e-emaan mein hai wahid, hai rahnuma himmat-e-mardanaye Qasim janbaaz-e-fidakaar hai parwanaye Qasim..
